content.comment_body: Is it possible to configure a time countdown on the [product_name]? For example, can you display a decrement from 10 minutes to 0 on the [product_name] operator display?
Hello, Yes, that's correct. I'm not sure why this detail isn't mentioned in the manual for the function block.
It seems you may not have fully read the manual. I've attached a relevant excerpt. Please refer to pages 219 and 220.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is seeking to configure a countdown timer, decrementing from a specified start time to zero, on a [product_name] device and visualize it using the [product_name] operator panel. There is uncertainty about whether this feature is available or documented, suggesting confusion and possible lack of clarity in the manual regarding timer functionality and visualization options.
